name: Fine Arts (BFA)
intro: The BFA is a four-year studio intensive program in preparation for a career in the fine arts, design and/or related fields or pursuit of a master of fine arts degree. With few required courses or electives and a wide variety of media from which to choose, the BFA provides ample opportunity to explore and develop a strong personal vision in art.

groups.rule: Three 4-unit foundation courses are required for students admitted to the BFA, Fine Arts
